profileValidity.interpretation: Actual samples[] count is primary. timeDeltas contain negative values: do not turn signed intervals or hitCount into precise CPU milliseconds, pause durations or rates. alignment.method: Intersect Start capture bracket with Stop capture bracket minus exported duration; locate Play inside its existing host input bracket. This is conditional elapsed-clock association, not exact target-clock synchronization.

windows.meaning: Definitely before Play under host/capture clock association; includes profiler startup and control interaction, not a clean idle baseline.

processFootprint.source: Root current normal-baseline result, same guarded process watch; root report retains raw evidence hashes.
processFootprint.interpretation: Growth persists under this profiling condition and remains high during bounded paused drain. Starting footprint is already warm/high. Android Unknown is not JS heap or a named allocator; CPU does not assign this growth to a source owner. No per-frame growth ratio is computed from mismatched windows.

decisions.finding: Both stellar projection and actual WeChat data/template update paths have substantial samples. Stellar transform ownership is semantically attributable; generic render/memo and template nodes still need the official packaged-script mapping before exact-line optimization.
decisions.nextAction: Use these owners for a focused responsiveness investigation when A is next. Preserve accepted identity, complete BSC/SAO and resource demand. Do not claim a CPU improvement or change page-state ownership from this one sample.

decisions.finding: The normal run reproduces process growth with real accepted/copy/GPU work; CPU stacks and GC samples do not explain allocation volume or retention.
decisions.nextAction: Keep the validated ordinary true-debug allocation-sampling route as the next discriminating B observation, coupled to actual Sky and the current packaged script/source mapping. Do not run another adjacent disable or parked scene-memo variant merely because it is prepared.

decisions.finding: This CPU file is a useful nonempty Sky capture. Another CPU recording or failed heavy heap/native route would repeat a qualified boundary without resolving B.
decisions.nextAction: Reuse this sample. Obtain the narrow official runtime-to-Taro map or exported packaged script only through an existing supported route if exact-line attribution changes the next decision; keep the gap until available.

limitations: CPU sample counts are not allocation sizes, retained objects, precise thread CPU duration, native/GPU duration or physical FPS.
